Task.Name: Phase 1: RSS Feed Reader & Infrastructure Foundation
[P1-01] Domain & Cloud Infrastructure Setup
Task.Notes: Registered feedometer.com on Hostinger, configured Cloudflare DNS, SSL/TLS certificates, custom apex/www domain routing, and Cloudflare Pages hosting.

Task.Name: [P1-02] GitHub Repository & Production Build Pipeline
Task.Notes: Initialized GitHub repository, configured branch workflows, and implemented automated production minification engine (build.js) achieving -38% payload reduction.

Task.Name: [P1-03] Cloudflare D1 Database & KV Schema Architecture
Task.Notes: Created feedometer-db D1 database, defined publishers, feeds, and notify_signups tables with unique indexes, and bound FEEDS_KV for multi-tier global caching.

Task.Name: [P1-04] Cloudflare Edge Worker API & Routing Engine
Task.Notes: Engineered stateless feedometer-worker.js with sub-10ms Edge Cache API (caches.default), KV fallback, /api/view, /api/catalog, /api/og, and /api/waitlist routes.

Task.Name: [P1-05] Universal XML Parsing & Layer A Image Extraction
Task.Notes: Built universal namespace-agnostic RSS 2.0 / Atom 1.0 parser with deep extraction for Media RSS (, ), iTunes enclosures, and inline .

Task.Name: [P1-06] URL Canonicalization, Deduplication & Safety Moderation
Task.Notes: Implemented tracking parameter stripping (utm_*, fbclid), canonical article URL generation, atomic title-hash deduplication, and automated hate speech/extremism content filter.

Task.Name: [P1-07] Server-Side Async Hero Image Enrichment & KV Caching
Task.Notes: Added non-blocking ctx.waitUntil OpenGraph hero image extraction with per-article KV caching (og:, 7-day TTL), eliminating all client-side scraping loops.

Task.Name: [P1-08] Dynamic 25-Outlet Publisher Directory & D1 Seeding
Task.Notes: Seeded 25 curated news publishers and sub-topics into D1 (seed_publishers.sql) with edge-cached /api/catalog route, stripping all hardcoded catalog JSON from frontend.

Task.Name: [P1-09] Pure Presentation Frontend & Master Design System
Task.Notes: Refactored feedometer-viewer.js to pure presentation (fetch -> render), declared master :root design tokens, standardized typography H1-H6, and unified .btn / .badge schemas.

Task.Name: [P2-01] Authentication Foundation
Task.Notes: Implement D1 user and session tables (users, sessions). Build password hashing (salted SHA-256), bearer token generation, session verification, POST /api/auth/register, POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/auth/logout, and GET /api/me to establish authenticated owner accounts from Day 1.

Task.Name: [P2-02] Stream Engine (The Heart)
Task.Notes: Build the core Stream Engine (/api/stream). Delivers multi-feed fusion (10 feeds -> 1 unified stream), universal JSON normalization ({id, title, summary, link, published, source, image}), cross-feed deduplication, and sub-100ms chronological sorting backed by multi-tier caching.

Task.Name: [P2-03] User Feed Management & Folders
Task.Notes: Implement D1-backed user subscriptions and folder hierarchy (user_sources, folders). Expose POST /api/follow, POST /api/unfollow, POST /api/folders/create, POST /api/folders/update, GET /api/my-feeds, and GET /api/my-folders with strict token authentication.

Task.Name: [P2-04] Feed Discovery Engine
Task.Notes: Build keyword and catalog search engine (/api/discover?q=...). Queries D1 catalog with verified badges, presents category starter pills (News, Tech, Finance, AI, EV), and returns suggested feeds for rapid user acquisition.

Task.Name: [P2-05] Universal Website Feed Builder & Newsletter Resolver
Task.Notes: Build universal website-to-feed ingestion tool (/api/builder). Probes input URLs, inspects headers, auto-resolves creator platforms (Substack, Beehiiv, Ghost, Medium), and provides fallback Edge HTML article extraction with live preview.

Task.Name: [P2-06] Personal Reader Actions (Starred, Read Later, History)
Task.Notes: Implement D1 tables for starred_articles, saved_articles, and read_history. Provide 1-click Star, Save Later, and Read/Unread tracking with endpoints POST /api/star, POST /api/save, GET /api/my-starred, GET /api/my-saved, and POST /api/read-history.

Task.Name: [P2-07] Thematic Collections Engine
Task.Notes: Build custom thematic collections (collections, collection_sources). Enables users to bundle related feeds into specialized topic collections and generate collection-filtered composite streams (/api/collections/:id/stream).

Task.Name: Phase 3: Cloud Identity, D1 Persistence & Device Sync
[P3-01] Passwordless Magic Link & OAuth Authentication
Task.Notes: Expand auth subsystem to support 1-click Magic Email Login (via Resend/Postmark) and Google/GitHub OAuth integrations with D1 user mapping.

Task.Name: [P3-02] Bidirectional Cloud Sync Engine (D1 ◄► Local)
Task.Notes: Build automatic background synchronization between client state and Cloudflare D1 database, ensuring instant multi-device continuity and offline resilience.

Task.Name: [P3-03] User Profile & Persistent Cloud Preferences
Task.Notes: Store user layout preferences, reading theme (dark/light/sepia), refresh frequencies, and default start pages in D1 user settings.

Task.Name: [P3-04] Multi-Device Session Management & Live Broadcast
Task.Notes: Handle secure HTTP-only session cookies and cross-tab BroadcastChannel communication for instant multi-tab status synchronization.

Task.Name: [P4-01] Global Feed Directory & Autodiscovery Search
Task.Notes: Enhance feed search modal with category exploration, popularity rankings from D1, and real-time website URL RSS autodiscovery.

Task.Name: [P4-02] Saved Searches & Dynamic Smart Feeds
Task.Notes: Allow users to save recurring search queries as dynamic "Smart Feeds" that automatically aggregate matching articles across all subscribed feeds.

Task.Name: [P4-03] Multi-Dimensional Article Tags & Categories
Task.Notes: Implement custom tag pills on articles with tag filtering, allowing multi-label cross-categorization outside traditional folder hierarchies.

Task.Name: [P4-04] Public Collections & Shareable Reading Lists
Task.Notes: Generate unique public share links for user-curated feed bundles or article collections with custom branded landing cards.

Task.Name: [P4-05] Feed Health, Uptime & Latency Diagnostics
Task.Notes: Provide an automated health monitoring dashboard showing feed response times, HTTP status codes, and last-successful-fetch timestamps.

Task.Name: [P5-01] Edge Rules & Boolean Query Parser Engine
Task.Notes: Build a serverless edge evaluation engine in Cloudflare Worker with full Boolean AST evaluation (AND, OR, NOT, exact quotes, nested parentheses, field targeting title:, source:, author:).

Task.Name: [P5-02] Notification Dispatcher (Email & Web Push)
Task.Notes: Integrate real-time notification dispatching supporting Web Push API (VAPID) and instant email alerts via transactional mail API.

Task.Name: [P5-03] Outbound Webhook Dispatcher
Task.Notes: Trigger secure JSON POST webhook payloads to custom HTTP endpoints whenever high-priority keyword or filter rules match incoming articles.

Task.Name: [P5-04] SaaS Integrations (Slack, Discord, Teams, Zapier)
Task.Notes: Pre-built webhook connectors formatting article rich cards directly into Slack channels, Discord webhooks, Microsoft Teams, and Zapier triggers.

Task.Name: [P5-05] Newsletter Digest Builder Studio
Task.Notes: A visual newsletter creator that compiles top starred/curated articles of the week into a responsive HTML email digest.

Task.Name: [P6-01] 1-Click Executive AI Article Summaries
Task.Notes: Integrate Cloudflare Workers AI (@cf/meta/llama-3-8b-instruct) to generate concise 2-bullet executive summaries directly inside article cards with KV response caching.

Task.Name: [P6-02] AI Topic Clustering & Semantic De-duplication
Task.Notes: Use Cloudflare Vectorize / Text Embeddings to cluster breaking news stories across multiple publishers into single aggregated topic streams.

Task.Name: [P6-03] Brand, Competitor & Executive Tracker
Task.Notes: Automated entity extraction and sentiment analysis tracking specific companies, brand mentions, and executive announcements across global feeds.

Task.Name: [P6-04] AI Research Assistant & Interactive Q&A
Task.Notes: Interactive AI chatbot enabling users to ask questions, extract key takeaways, and synthesize trends across saved article collections.

Task.Name: [P7-01] Multi-Tenant Team Workspaces Architecture
Task.Notes: Implement multi-tenant workspace partitioning in Cloudflare D1 with workspace switcher, shared feed collections, and team member management.

Task.Name: [P7-02] Role-Based Access Control (Admin/Editor/Viewer)
Task.Notes: Granular permissions granting Admins billing/member management, Editors feed/rule curation, and Viewers read-only dashboard access.

Task.Name: [P7-03] Enterprise SSO (SAML / OIDC) & Audit Logs
Task.Notes: Single Sign-On integration via Cloudflare Access / Okta / Azure AD with comprehensive compliance audit logging for team actions.

Task.Name: [P7-04] Developer Public REST API & API Key Management
Task.Notes: Expose secure REST API with API key token generation, rate limiting, and OpenAPI/Swagger interactive documentation.

Task.Name: [P7-05] Embeddable Widget Studio & Live Visual Publishing Modes
Task.Notes: Visual widget builder offering 6 layout modes (News Wall, Breaking News Ticker, Carousel Slider, Magazine Grid, Imageboard, Classic List) and responsive iframe embed snippet generation.
